notes.title: Additional Fixes
notes.content:
The following was fixed:
[list]
[*] Arwen's portrait bust will now correctly be removed while travelling through the Lovebirds Valley.
[*] After teleporting from Shrine of Lovebirds, the menu background will correctly change to Fallhorn city.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Arwen's portrait bust will now correctly be removed while travelling through the Lovebirds Valley.
[*] After teleporting from Shrine of Lovebirds, the menu background will correctly change to Fallhorn city.

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
The following was fixed:
[list]
[*] Required Level to learn a talent will now be more visible in the talent menu when a character does not meet the required level.
[*] After teleporting back to Fallhorn from the Shrine, the Active Quest Window will no longer be missing.
[*] Some grammar.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Required Level to learn a talent will now be more visible in the talent menu when a character does not meet the required level.
[*] After teleporting back to Fallhorn from the Shrine, the Active Quest Window will no longer be missing.
[*] Some grammar.

notes.title: Quick Fix
notes.content:
Things that were fixed:
[list]
[*] When using the [b]OPTIMIZE[/b] option in the Equip screen, items for which the level requirement is not met will no longer be equipped.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] When using the [b]OPTIMIZE[/b] option in the Equip screen, items for which the level requirement is not met will no longer be equipped.

notes.title: Small Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
The following was changed:
[list]
[*] In-game playtime will now be more accurate.
[*] Some grammar mistakes were corrected.
[*] Title menu graphics have been slightly changed.
[/list]

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
[b]The following was fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer be able to skip Ryder's first few turns when rescuing Arwen.
[*] The flickering in the catacombs has been slightly improved.
[/list]

tags.bug: Players will no longer be able to skip Ryder's first few turns when rescuing Arwen.
The flickering in the catacombs has been slightly improved.

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[b]The following was fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] After rescuing Arwen, when going back to the beach, the slimes will no longer roam weirdly.
[*] The final scene of the game will no longer get stuck sometimes in an endless loop.
[/list]

tags.bug: After rescuing Arwen, when going back to the beach, the slimes will no longer roam weirdly.
